chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

When my father (peace be upon him) was about to pass away, he said to me: 'O my son! He who holds the Prayer in light estimation will not attain our intercession, and he who is habitual in these drinks will not return to us at the Fountain.' So I said: 'O father! And which drinks?' So he said: 'Every intoxicant.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of neglecting prayer and habitual consumption of intoxicants according to Imam Al-Hadi (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the critical link between ritual prayer and intercession, while specifically identifying habitual consumption of any intoxicant as a barrier to reaching the Prophet's and Imams' Fountain (Al-Hawd). In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted to mean that while occasional use may not exclude one entirely, addiction or regularity ('adama') in drinking any intoxicant leads to missing the Hawd, emphasizing the spiritual consequences of substance abuse beyond mere prohibition.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was about to pass away, he<sup>asws</sup> said to me<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! He would not attain our<sup>asws</sup> intercession, the one who holds the Prayer in light estimation, nor would he return to us<sup>asws</sup> at the Fountain, the one who is habitual in these drinks’. So I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O father<sup>asws</sup>! And which drinks?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Every intoxicant’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When my father was about to pass away he said to me, ‘My son, our intercession will not apply to those who take their Salat (prayer) lightly and the addicts of these drinks will not be able to come to us at the pond. I then asked, ‘What are these drinks, O father?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is all intoxicating liquor.’”
